summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the ExcelIntel web preview. All 9 pytest backend cases pass (100%). Frontend Playwright test verifies header, KPIs, both charts, samples list (5 items), data table + search, duplicate scan flow, threshold slider, Relationships tab (auto-discovered customer_id/state links with 99% confidence), Command Palette via Ctrl+P and button (with Escape close), and all 6 screenshot thumbnails. KPI values match spec (Files=4, Sheets=4, Total Rows=1,538, Unique=1,538, Duplicates=0, Missing=40, Quality=99.7, Validation=100.0).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: cache dict `_dataset_cache` grows unbounded — fine for a preview but consider LRU for prod.
server.py `top_values`: accesses vc[0] before checking if vc is non-empty (IndexError if column has no values). Minor edge-case.
Header sub-text says 'Enterprise Excel Analytics · offline' while a separate 'API online' badge is shown — slightly conflicting wording but not a bug.
seed_data_creation: None — used the pre-existing sample files in /app/samples/
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL comes from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Regression suite in /app/backend/tests/test_excelintel_api.py covers /api/, /api/samples, /api/summary, /api/duplicates (default + custom threshold), /api/relationships, /api/dataset, /api/screenshots/{name} (200 + 404). Frontend uses data-testid consistently: sample-<filename>, chart-rows-by-sheet, chart-quality, samples-list, data-table, data-search, scan-duplicates-btn, run-dup-btn, threshold-slider, tab-relationships, relationships-list, command-palette, palette-input, open-palette-btn, duplicates-list, screenshot-<name>.
